_comment: SDLC ontology for the engram-mcp server. Three layers (code / process / team). `classes` guide how the distill skill CLASSIFIES an entity; the stored entity `kind` is still a built-in variant (function, class, struct, concept, api, ...). `within` predicates relate things inside a layer; `across` predicates bridge layers (e.g. a Requirement `realizes` a Feature, a Feature `describes` a function). Edit freely — it is read at server launch.
